topic: Save and restore best state across search mode switches
principle: When switching between exploitation and exploration modes in a search algorithm, save the best solution and fitness from the exploitation phase before entering exploration. When returning from exploration, restore the saved state. Otherwise, exploration discoveries will permanently overwrite the exploitation best, losing all progress.
instruction: My novelty search mode keeps overwriting the best circuit found in target mode
good_example:
if switching_to_novelty:
    saved_best_ast = best_ast
    saved_best_penalty = best_penalty
    best_penalty = 1000.0
if switching_to_target:
    best_ast = saved_best_ast
    best_penalty = saved_best_penalty
